label: ACM CPU nodes

cpuSpecs.cache: 256 MB L3 per CPU · 512 MB total

description: CPU-focused ICER nodes for parallel simulations, data preparation, numerical libraries, and independent batch jobs.
tidbit: This profile describes one node in acm-000–047, not the combined cluster. A scheduler allocation may give your job only part of that node’s cores and memory.
goodFor: Parallel CPU simulations, numerical libraries, preprocessing, and batches of independent CPU tasks. Each node combines 128 physical EPYC cores with 493 GB of published job-available RAM.
limitations: No compute GPU is included in this profile, so CUDA GPU work needs a different node. Serial code will not use 128 cores automatically. Memory-heavy jobs must fit their allocation; multiple nodes do not automatically share RAM.

cpu.title: AMD EPYC 7763
cpu.goodFor: Parallel simulations, numerical libraries, and batches of independent CPU tasks.
cpu.limitations: CUDA GPU workloads, AVX-512-only code, or expecting serial programs to use all 128 cores.

memory.title: 493 GB · memory available to jobs
memory.text: ICER’s published table lists this memory capacity per node. Your job’s actual memory limit depends on the resources requested and allocated by the scheduler.
memory.tidbit: Memory on different cluster nodes is not one automatic shared pool. Multi-node applications need explicit distributed communication.
